rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a knitted warm top, including one worn by athletes before or after exercise.

example.english: After exercising, even if you are sweaty, put your sweater back on before you leave.
example.traditional: 做完運動出晒汗，都要着返件冷衫先好走。
example.jyutping: zou6 jyun4 wan6 dung6 ceot1 saai3 hon6 dou1 jiu3 zoek3 faan1 gin6 laang1 saam1 sin1 hou2 zau2
